findings: Missing ranking artifacts — ranking_model.joblib and context_vectors.npz not present in artifacts directory. Implementation correctly falls back to heuristic, but learned path cannot be exercised without running training notebook and passing ship‑gate.

Token‑based parsing still partial‑word vulnerable — token splitter treats apostrophes as separators, so compound tokens like 'commercial' become single tokens; 'mer' inside doesn't match. Risk limited to future keyword additions.

Historical RAG degrades with deleted items — when item deleted from Pinecone, embedding missing from fetch_embeddings. Outfit vector computed only from present items, may distort historical reference. Code skips groups with <2 present embeddings.

Explanation truncation silent — LLM‑generated explanations longer than 2048 characters (Outfit.explanation column length) silently truncated without warning. Design folds adjustment suggestions into explanation text, increasing overflow risk.
